title: Planner Agent in Copilot Chat: task assignment, scheduled catch-up and memory
summary: The notice, roadmap record and Microsoft documentation support the briefing's actionable claims, including the default, licensing and control calls. Minor corrections remain: keep the December rollout conditional in the explanatory prose, and reconcile the usage-report checklist step with the controls table.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The general Block action is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents. ... In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package.
claims.quote: Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.claim: The documented general Block action restricts agent access organisation-wide.
claims.quote: Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.claim: The cited package-block API is beta.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change.

claims.claim: Use of that beta package API in production applications is unsupported.
claims.quote: Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Access to the Package Management API requires Microsoft Agent 365 licensing.
claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: The block API requires delegated CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All permission.
claims.quote: Delegated (work or school account) | CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All ... Application | Not available.

claims.claim: The generic documentation does not show the Planner Agent entry or establish that the package-block API applies to it.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Planner Agent" "Planner" "admin" access user interface AllowPlannerCopilot'; opened Agent actions, Manage agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center and copilotPackage: block. No Planner-specific entry or API mapping found.

claims.claim: Pinning management is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > Registry > ellipsis menu > Manage pinned agents.
claims.quote: Registry refers to the agent inventory under Agents > All agents > Registry ... In All agents, select the ellipse on the right to display a dropdown menu. ... Select Manage pinned agents.

claims.claim: No API for administrator pinning of these Copilot agents was found.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Manage pinned agents" Graph API pin copilotPackage' and '"Graph" "pin" "copilotPackage" "agent"'; read agent-registry-overview pinning steps and search excerpts for Graph API for agent registry and copilotPackage properties. No pinning operation found.

claims.claim: Administrators can scope pinned agents to users or groups.
claims.quote: Administrators can choose to pin an agent for all users in the tenant or for specific users or groups.

claims.claim: Administrators can pin up to three agents.
claims.quote: Administrators can pin up to three agents in Microsoft 365 admin center for end-users using Microsoft Copilot in the organization.

claims.claim: Pinning changes visibility rather than granting agent access.
claims.quote: The agent to pin must be discoverable by the member of your organization ... You can only pin agents that are deployed to some or all users.

claims.where: controls[2].governs, controls[2].scope; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Enhanced personalization is a general tenant-level control over Copilot memory, including the memory Planner Agent uses.
claims.quote: No action is required to turn on Copilot memory; you only need to turn off Copilot memory for end-users or the tenant if desired. Enhanced personalization is the control that allows Copilot memory to be used by end-users.

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization stops Copilot from applying saved memories.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Saved memories control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization does not remove saved memories.
claims.quote: Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat, but doesn't remove saved memories.

claims.claim: No administrator UI equivalent of the documented Planner-in-Planner access policy was found.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Planner Agent" "Planner" "admin" access user interface AllowPlannerCopilot'; opened /planner/turn-off-planner-agent. It documents PowerShell access policy; its admin-center link concerns the separate Microsoft Copilot experience.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id> enables Planner Agent in Planner for a specified security group.
claims.quote: To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>

claims.claim: The Planner cmdlet documentation applies to Planner Agent in Planner rather than establishing that the cmdlet governs Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Applies to: Planner Agent in Planner ... For information on how to manage the Planner Agent in Microsoft Copilot, please see Manage agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: Changes to that Planner access policy can take up to one hour.
claims.quote: Changes may take up to 1 hour to reflect across your organization.

claims.claim: The Planner Agent documentation says it plans to provide the same auditing capabilities as premium plans.
claims.quote: Planner Agent plans to provide the same auditing capabilities as premium plans (previously Project for the Web projects).

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends confirming that users have an active Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: We recommend that you: ... Confirm that users have an active Microsoft Copilot license.
